'''Arrata''' is a [[Seanchan]] soldier under the command of [[Bakayar Mishima]] during the [[Shaido War]]. 

==Appearance==
Arrata is a wiry woman who wears a red Seanchan soldier's coat.{{ref/book|11|26}}

==Activities==
She earns [[Perrin Aybara]]'s ire when she slashes open her sack and spills a handful of precious [[forkroot]] pellets onto the ground. Perrin admonshes her for not opening it directly over the opening to the aqueduct that supplies water to [[Malden]], [[Altara]].{{ref/book|11|26}}

==In the television series==
In the television series, {{TVlink|Arrata}} is played by actress {{TVlink|Seraphina Beh}}.
